Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the directors’ birth years, incorrectly stating Georges Méliès (Christ Walking on the Water) was born in 1898 and James Tinling (45 Fathers) in 1861, contradicting the gathered sources (Méliès: 1861; Tinling: 1889 or 1898). This misattribution led to the wrong conclusion; regardless of the Tinling discrepancy, 45 Fathers’ director was born later.
